key.name: language
key.summary: Language of the widget and its preferences: 'auto' follows the system, otherwise a language code such as 'en' or 'it'

key.name: theme
key.summary: Widget color theme

key.name: columns
key.summary: Lay the sections out in one or two columns

key.name: position
key.summary: Widget position on the desktop

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Background opacity (percent)

key.name: scale
key.summary: Widget size (percent)

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Connector of the monitor showing the widget (e.g. HDMI-1); empty = primary monitor

key.name: margin
key.summary: Distance from the screen edges (pixels)

key.name: sky-background
key.summary: Tint the background like the sky (time of day and weather)

key.name: show-header
key.summary: Show host name and uptime

key.name: show-weather
key.summary: Show current weather

key.name: show-forecast
key.summary: Show the forecast for the next days

key.name: show-hourly
key.summary: Show the next hours (every two hours) with temperature and chance of rain

key.name: show-rain
key.summary: Show rain expected in the next two hours

key.name: show-sun
key.summary: Show the sun arc, moon phase, sunrise and sunset

key.name: show-air
key.summary: Show air quality, UV index and pollen

key.name: show-advice
key.summary: Show the tip of the day

key.name: show-quakes
key.summary: Show recent earthquakes nearby

key.name: show-alerts
key.summary: Show the weather warnings in force for the region (MeteoAlarm)

key.name: show-system
key.summary: Show CPU, memory and disk

key.name: show-details
key.summary: Show network, load, fans and battery

key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: System data refresh interval (seconds)

key.name: show-clock
key.summary: Show the UTC clock and the Unix time in the header

key.name: show-processes
key.summary: Show the processes using most CPU and memory

key.name: show-network
key.summary: Show public IP, VPN, Wi-Fi, local address, gateway and DNS

key.name: show-ports
key.summary: Show listening ports and active connections

key.name: show-latency
key.summary: Show the latency graph

key.name: latency-host
key.summary: Host probed for the latency (TCP port 443)

key.name: mask-public-ip
key.summary: Hide the last two octets of the public IP address

key.name: network-interval
key.summary: Network data refresh interval (seconds)

key.name: public-ip-interval
key.summary: Public IP refresh interval (minutes)

key.name: show-security
key.summary: Show firewall, updates, failed logins, sessions, Secure Boot, encryption

key.name: hover-details
key.summary: Show a popup with the details of a security chip or a feed entry when the pointer rests on it

key.name: security-interval
key.summary: Security data refresh interval (minutes)

key.name: show-feeds
key.summary: Show the newest CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

key.name: show-cert-agid
key.summary: Show the latest CERT-AGID news

key.name: feeds-interval
key.summary: Feeds refresh interval (minutes)

key.name: show-space
key.summary: Show space weather (Kp index) and the ISS position

key.name: notify-vpn
key.summary: Send a desktop notification when the VPN drops

key.name: notify-ransomware
key.summary: Send a desktop notification when CISA adds a vulnerability used by ransomware

key.name: notify-logins
key.summary: Send a desktop notification when failed logins pile up between two checks

key.name: notify-weather-alerts
key.summary: Send a desktop notification for new orange and red weather warnings

key.name: kev-notified-date
key.summary: Newest "date added" of the ransomware entries already notified (internal)

key.name: location-mode
key.summary: How the weather location is determined

key.name: city-name
key.summary: Display name of the manually chosen city

key.name: city-region
key.summary: Region (first-level administrative area) of the manually chosen city, for the weather warnings

key.name: city-country
key.summary: ISO 3166-1 country code of the manually chosen city

key.name: latitude
key.summary: Latitude of the manually chosen city

key.name: longitude
key.summary: Longitude of the manually chosen city

key.name: units
key.summary: Units for temperatures and wind speed

key.name: weather-interval
key.summary: Weather refresh interval (minutes)

key.name: quake-min-magnitude
key.summary: Smallest earthquake magnitude to report

key.name: quake-radius
key.summary: Earthquake search radius (km)
